record.description: Enter what you know. You can leave value unknown and come back later.
record.numericEntryHelp: Use Latin digits 0–9 and a decimal point in number fields. Falc also understands Arabic-Indic digits in chat.
record.name: Give it a name
record.giftNote: Gift / non-financial records are kept for your notes but left out of asset and net-worth totals.
record.refundHelp: For an application awaiting allocation, refunded money is excluded from its value.
record.propertyShareHelp: Enter only your share of the property value below—not the whole property's value.
record.worthNow: What could it be worth now?
record.debtValueHelp: Enter the current amount owed, not the original loan.
record.ipoValueHelp: For a pending application, enter the gross amount paid; refunded cash is subtracted.
record.unitsValueHelp: Enter the total value of all your shares or units, not the price of one. No live prices.
record.goldValueHelp: Enter your estimated resale value, not the price per gram. Making charges may not be recoverable.
record.estimateHelp: Use an estimate or your latest statement. No live prices.
record.unknownDateHelp: Unknown values still need a date for this record.
record.valueSource: How did you get this value?
record.unknownValue: I don't know the current value yet
record.accessHelp: Only items you mark as available appear in the “Easy to access” estimate.
record.notePlaceholder: Anything you'll want to remember later
record.saveError: Could not save this item. Please check the details and try again.

activity.title: Record an activity
activity.description: Track money moving in or out, or record a fresh value for an item.
activity.repaymentHelp: This repayment lowers the outstanding balance (or the amount owed to you) when that value is known. Enter no more than the balance shown.
activity.valuationHelp: This sets the record’s current value to the amount entered and uses the event date as its value date.
activity.incomeHelp: This records a distribution received. It is not treated as reinvested or added to the investment’s current value.
activity.activityHelp: This appears in your activity history and updates the saved value when one is already known. It never fetches a live price.
